QuestInfo.name: [Express] A World Away
QuestInfo.0: Ask Eremos where your next training location is.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos is sending you to Ludibrium for the next phase of your training, but he strikes you as a bit disdainful of this new locale. He simply tells you to defeat 1,000 monsters.
QuestInfo.2: When the two of you discuss the progress of your training, Surana reveals Eremos' strong dislike of mechanical lifeforms.
